input: Get a structural engineer to inspect the basement crack

gold.taskTitle: Get a structural engineer to inspect basement crack
gold.taskDescription: Find and hire a structural engineer to inspect a crack in the basement and assess its severity.

questions.title: How long has the crack been there?
questions.description: Understanding the age of the crack helps determine urgency and whether it has been growing.

questions.title: Is the crack horizontal, vertical, or diagonal?
questions.description: The orientation of the crack is a key detail for the engineer and affects how serious the issue might be.

questions.title: Roughly how long and wide is the crack?
questions.description: The size of the crack helps assess urgency and what kind of specialist may be needed.

questions.title: Is the crack in the floor, wall, or foundation footing?
questions.description: The exact location of the crack within the basement determines the structural concern and inspection approach.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred timeline for the inspection?
questions.description: Knowing whether this is urgent or flexible helps prioritize finding and scheduling an engineer.

questions.title: Do you already have an engineer in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user needs help finding an engineer or just scheduling one shapes the next steps.

questions.title: Are you filing this through a home insurance claim?
questions.description: Insurance involvement changes documentation requirements and may affect which engineers can be hired.
